reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, brand, unit_cost_eur,
       MAX(unit_cost_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY brand) AS brand_max_cost
FROM products
WHERE category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
alternatives:
WITH brand_max AS (  -- one row per brand with TV & Video products
  SELECT brand, MAX(unit_cost_eur) AS max_cost
  FROM products
  WHERE category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
  GROUP BY brand
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.brand, p.unit_cost_eur, bm.max_cost AS brand_max_cost
FROM products p
JOIN brand_max bm ON bm.brand = p.brand
WHERE p.category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6

SELECT p.product_id, p.brand, p.unit_cost_eur,
       (SELECT MAX(p2.unit_cost_eur) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.brand = p.brand AND p2.category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6) AS brand_max_cost
FROM products p
WHERE p.category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6

other_way.sql:
WITH brand_max AS (  -- one row per brand with TV & Video products
  SELECT brand, MAX(unit_cost_eur) AS max_cost
  FROM products
  WHERE category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
  GROUP BY brand
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.brand, p.unit_cost_eur, bm.max_cost AS brand_max_cost
FROM products p
JOIN brand_max bm ON bm.brand = p.brand
WHERE p.category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
other_way.tradeoff: A per-brand step joined back gives the same rows on any engine, but the category filter must then be written twice.
